question: Choose the correct meaning of Idiom "**Flog a dead horse".**

options.text: Waste time on a lost cause

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "Waste time on a lost cause". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Flog a dead horse"** means to waste effort on something that has no chance of success. (बेकार काम में समय बर्बाद करना) • **Example: **Trying to convince him to change his decision is like flogging a dead horse. • The correct meaning of the idiom is to persist with an action or argument that is no longer relevant or productive. (अप्रासंगिक या अनुपयोगी कार्य में लगे रहना) • **Example: **Debating this topic again is pointless – we’re just flogging a dead horse. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Beat an opponent unfairly **(प्रतिद्वंद्वी को अनुचित तरीके से हराना): To use dishonest methods to win against someone. • **Example:** He was accused of beating his opponent unfairly in the game. • **Option 2: Repeat a settled argument **(एक सुलझी हुई बहस को दोहराना): To bring up a discussion that has already been resolved. • **Example: ** There’s no point in repeating this settled argument; it’s already been decided. • **Option 3: Chase an impossible goal **(असंभव लक्ष्य का पीछा करना): To pursue something that is unrealistic or unattainable. • **Example:** Trying to find a unicorn in the forest is chasing an impossible goal. 7c:Tf6e, The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Earthly**.
